preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The number of paths must be greater than zero.

postconditions.expression: all(len(path) > 0 and len(path) <= n - 1 for path in paths)
postconditions.description: Each path must have a length greater than zero and less than or equal to n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 1 for x in points)
postconditions.description: The distance x for each point must be between 0 and 1.
